reviews.t: 4 out of 5 - Good shaver but comes up short
reviews.x: Overall I am satisfied with my purchase, but the arcitec leaves a bit to be desired for sure.  The razor works great on my cheeks, upper lip and also my chin but does poorly on my lower neck.  No matter how many times I go over the area of my neck, the razor won't trim those hairs. claims.text: Many reviewers praise the close, comfortable shave, with several calling it the closest they've had from an electric razor.
A common complaint is poor coverage on the neck and missed patches, making shaving slow or requiring extra passes.
Reviewers frequently note the shaver is easy and efficient to clean, especially under running tap water.
Some long-time Norelco users find the new Arcitec design shaves worse or more harshly than previous models, despite its fancy look.
Several reviewers mention the body feels lightweight and flimsy or awkward to hold.
